purpose: Original editorial category artwork replacing repeated Xbox 360 logo card images. Illustrative scenes, not screenshots or installation diagrams.

images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original 16:9 website card illustration, landscape. Create a premium photorealistic editorial still life about Xbox 360 homebrew installation. Scene: a deep charcoal studio surface. Main subject: an authentic white original-generation Xbox 360 standing at a slight three-quarter angle with its removable grey hard drive attached; a compact USB flash drive rests clearly beside it. Restrained Xbox-green rim light, small warm amber accent, tactile plastic, subtle surface reflections, crisp realistic details. A quiet abstract green connection arc between drive and console evokes a connected homebrew setup without depicting software UI. Large simple subjects readable at 300px card width, generous margins so neither object is cut off when cropped to 16:9. Calm technical mood, sophisticated dark composition. No headline text, no labels, no watermarks, no fabricated screen interface, no large brand wordmark. This is an illustrative category image, not an installation diagram.
images.review: Visually inspected: large readable subjects, landscape 16:9 framing, dark studio styling, no headline labels or watermark.
